resolvedQuestions.text: What should /doctor:speckit do with non-zero phraseQuality diagnostics, given the lookup ranking behavior, and how should DOC-349/DOC-350 and tests change?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Re-rank phrase quality as an advisory outside staleness_signals/staleness_classes/severity_max; report per-class counts and share in a quality_advisories block; align the YAML status enum with the presentation; DOC-349 becomes fresh-index STATUS_OK with the advisory visible, DOC-350 keeps index_content_stale STATUS_STALE plus an isolation assertion; keep generator tests and add doctor-level contract tests. Lookup ranking, generator diagnostics and the corpus stay unchanged.

resolvedQuestions.text: What unknown-flag error should /doctor:mcp add, and how do the other doctor command contracts handle unknown arguments today?
resolvedQuestions.answer: For a recognized sub-action reject a flag present in neither schema before YAML load with STATUS=FAIL ERROR="unknown_flag", naming the flag, sub-action and its valid flags, while keeping cross_sub_action_flag_injection for known other-sub-action flags. Add the wording to mcp.md and the presentation and create DOC-379; every sibling router already separates unknown from cross-* misuse.

resolvedQuestions.text: How can a long-lived local /doctor:update environment exercise customized, conflict, removed and local-only units across record-base/check/align/apply/rollback, including release-tag and worktree constraints?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Create the sk-git allocator worktree worktrees/{NNN}-doctor-update-test-environment at v4.0.0.0 with --no-provision (the requested literal name is out of grammar; detached HEAD is unusable because commits are required). Overlay the current updater assets, commit the four fixtures (webflow SKILL.md edit, Barter sk-git plus a forced release-changed conflict anchor, new sk-code-web-dev packet, local v4.0.0.3-fixture deleting sk-code-obsidian), record-base offline with --trust-release, commit base.json, and reset apply via rollback --run=<runDir>. Prefer the derived web-dev packet over stripping sk-code modes.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which other doctor-command playbooks should reuse that environment, which exact scenario files change, and what new scenarios are added?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Six of seven non-updater commands gain (speckit, runtime-mirrors, skill-advisor, env, mcp, git standards; deep-loop only DOC-368). Change 23 existing scenario files plus 4 READMEs (12+README system-spec-kit, 4 system-skill-advisor, 1+README system-deep-loop, 3+README sk-git, 3+README mcp-code-mode). DOC-370 stays on a disposable clone because linked worktrees share Git config. Create DOC-379 doctor-mcp-unknown-flag and DOC-380 doctor-update-environment.

keyFindings.text: corpus_pollution is a freshness-class signal with 251 flagged phrases of 33,719 always present, so a fresh index can never reach STATUS=OK; make it an advisory outside severity_max.
Phrase-quality pollution is a persistent diagnostic advisory, not index staleness severity.
The lookup ranks exact and qualifying multi-token matches without consulting phraseQuality.

The never-rank rationale is too broad: exact matches score before the token floor and multi-token flagged classes can score by containment or overlap; the lookup never consults phraseQuality and the generator keeps the phrases.
/doctor:mcp needs an unknown_flag error for flags in neither schema, distinct from cross_sub_action_flag_injection, rendered before YAML load with the sub-action's valid flags.
MCP should distinguish unknown flags from known cross-sub-action flags.

Create the environment as worktrees/{NNN}-doctor-update-test-environment from v4.0.0.0 with --no-provision; the literal .doctor-update-test-environment name is outside the validated sk-git grammar and detached HEAD cannot hold the required commits.
Historical .0/.2 worktrees need current updater assets overlaid; scope command:doctor out of unit status checks.

The release tags carry only the legacy updater, so the fixture overlays the current update.md, _routes.yaml, presentation, five action YAMLs and release-update.cjs; that overlay is one unit, command:commands/doctor, kept out of assertion scopes.
Use controlled local fixtures for the four unit statuses and a local synthetic deletion target because stock .0->.2 has no removed skill unit.
Commit fixture and base manifest; rollback immediately and verify no skipped paths before resetting the scenario.

Four fixtures give all statuses: customized via sk-code-webflow SKILL.md edit, conflict via Barter sk-git plus a forced release-changed path, removed via a local prerelease tag deleting sk-code-obsidian, local via a new sk-code-web-dev packet (staged so enumeration sees it).
Use sk-git numbered named-worktree grammar and a local long-lived branch.

Add the derived sk-code-web-dev packet instead of stripping modes; stripping breaks the hub's two-axis contract, produces mixed local/conflict units in deleted packets and forces router/registry/manifest edits.
Five doctor playbooks have 27 copy-based scenarios to migrate; two new scenarios cover updater lifecycle and MCP unknown flags.

Reset after apply with rollback --run=<runDir>: it restores before states, deletes added files, restores base.json/divergence.json, reports skipped paths with exit 1 and clears the lock; re-apply of the same run is refused once rollback.json exists.
DOC-349 changes to STATUS_OK with advisories; DOC-350 keeps STATUS_STALE with advisory isolation; generator tests stay and doctor-level contract tests are added.
All seven sibling doctor routers already separate unknown from cross-* misuse, so a dedicated MCP unknown_flag error matches the fleet.

The fixture baseline must be committed: apply refuses planned targets dirty against HEAD and record-base refuses a dirty base.json; offline record-base of v4.0.0.0 needs --trust-release and reports verified:false, then base.json is committed.

The Barter sk-git snapshot is absent, so its 10-file overlap is UNKNOWN; the replacement plan forces one release-changed path to differ locally for a deterministic conflict and runs after the worktree is created because the replacement removes the allocator.
Six of the seven non-updater doctor commands gain from the shared environment; deep-loop gains only for DOC-368 because its other scenarios require empty or specially populated graph states.
Exactly 23 existing scenario files plus 4 READMEs change across the five doctor-commands playbooks; DOC-351/364/365/367/369/374/378 are already copy-free.
DOC-370 must keep a disposable clone: it writes local Git config and a linked worktree resolves config and hooks to the shared common Git dir, so the fixture would mutate the main checkout's state.
Create DOC-379 doctor-mcp-unknown-flag and DOC-380 doctor-update-environment (shared-environment lifecycle and rollback reset contract).

Ordered plan: fix the contracts first, then build and commit the worktree fixtures, record and commit the base, migrate the 27 files and add the two scenarios, then verify with scoped dry-run-first actions and a rollback to baseline; never push the fixture branch or tag.
